source_shader.name: Hidden/TextOutline_Unlit
source_shader.selection_evidence: damage_runtime_constants.json and damage_ubertext_runtime.cil.*: zhCN=9, thTH=15. Only locale15 uses 2pass; richText=true does not select NoVertColor.

original_alpha_equation: saturate(sum of 9 atlas alpha taps) * vertexColor.a * _Color.a
conditions: _MainTex_ST is (1,1,0,0), as applicable to dynamic glyph atlas
Original sample_b uses _GlobalMipBias. A no-mipmap glyph atlas has no selectable lower mip.
Existing mask_backend_inverse is a separate Godot backend color conversion, not part of original shader equation.
godot_render_state_caveat: blend_mix matches original RGB factors, but Godot target-alpha factors can differ. A transparent offscreen/capture route must apply the existing source-alpha blend bridge. Direct RGB over an opaque board is not changed by target-alpha write factors.
scope: Static source compiled equation and state comparison. Does not claim final glyph atlas rasterization, pixel placement, or framebuffer pixels have been runtime-validated.
